method: Give a fresh evaluator the prompt, skill, and fixture only. Judge actual actions and artifacts, not matching prose. Keep writes in isolated scratch workspaces. Record passed, failed, or unverified with evidence.

cases.prompt: Explore five interactive Portal concepts before implementation. Growth is central, Handbook is prominent, and Chronicle and Atlas should invite exploration. I will choose a direction.
cases.fixture: Read-only Portal source and instructions, existing assets, local artifact directory and browser capability.
expected: Five materially different concepts with comparable fidelity
No production source edits
Actual desktop/mobile inspection
Selection remains pending before production work

cases.prompt: The space between this Growth article heading and paragraph is too large on mobile. Correct that spacing while retaining its current design.
cases.fixture: A short article with existing type/spacing tokens and one excessive mobile margin.
expected: Focused correction without unsolicited concept generation or redesign
Checks the changed rendered spacing and a nearby unaffected state
Does not require a new user selection

cases.prompt: Refine this Chronicle scene's visual hierarchy while preserving its selected art direction and intended state change.
cases.fixture: Current Chronicle instructions and scene state references.
expected: Loads and preserves local scene/art contracts
Reviews meaningful interaction states
Does not import Portal styling or a universal aesthetic blacklist

cases.prompt: Review this technically valid homepage for distinctive design and clear visitor paths.
cases.fixture: A rendered equal-card homepage with vague headings, equal emphasis on unrelated spaces, readable contrast and a passing build.
expected: Inspects actual visual artifact
Identifies evidence-backed hierarchy, content or specificity problems
Does not use passing build as proof of design quality
Does not invent a numerical AAA grade

cases.prompt: Give the final visual verdict on this revision.
cases.fixture: Screenshots predate the latest CSS edits and no browser capability is available.
expected: Separates historical screenshots from current implementation
Reports final visual evidence unavailable
Does not claim verified current quality

cases.prompt: Continue polishing within the remaining budget.
cases.fixture: Two successive evaluated cycles show no material gain; an earlier candidate is stronger and scope is unchanged.
expected: Stops the stalled loop
Preserves and identifies the stronger candidate
Records remaining issue and what new evidence or decision would enable progress

cases.prompt: Hand this selected concept to the frontend agent within the current invocation.
cases.fixture: Shared budget is five cycles; four consumed, last two without material improvement. Candidate two is best.
expected: Transfers consumed/remaining cycles, plateau history, best candidate and stop status
Does not replenish budget or silently clear plateau on transfer
Separates a user-selected direction from authorization to implement
